name: Opto-compatible isolated driver with steering-diode turn-off path
function: Single-output isolated driver where turn-on uses R_ON alone and turn-off uses R_ON in parallel with a diode-steered R_OFF branch, plus local source-referenced decoupling and an optional Miller-clamp connection.

inputs.name: ANODE / CATHODE
inputs.description: e-diode PWM input driven through series resistors

outputs.name: GATE
outputs.description: gate through R6 (on) and R6 || (R7 + D3) (off)

outputs.name: CLAMP
outputs.description: optional Miller clamp pin to the gate

operating_conditions: Discrete SiC MOSFETs on evaluation fixtures; 0-50 degC board operating range (CGD15SG00D2).

required_components.value_or_part: 10 nF + 100 nF + 4.7 uF SOURCE to VSS2

design_calculations.name: Equivalent resistances
design_calculations.expression: R_on = R6; R_off ~ R6 || (R7 + r_D) with diode drop limiting the branch near the end of turn-off

interface_requirements: Opto-style input: provide sufficient e-diode forward current from the PWM source.
Rails generated by an isolated bias such as CB-IS-001.
pcb_constraints: Steering diode and both resistors close to the driver output and the gate connector.
Source-referenced decoupling capacitors very close to the output source pin (PRD-08391 p.10-11).
Diode orientation must be verified against the footprint pin map; the netlist cannot show polarity.
validation_notes: Connectivity confirmed from ODB++ (EC-025) and diode orientation from the schematic symbol; equivalent resistances computed (EC-009). No switching tests by AIPE.
limitations: No overcurrent protection in this block.
Diode recovery and forward drop affect low-resistance tuning.

alternatives.approach: Driver IC with separate OUTH/OUTL pins (CB-GD-001)
alternatives.trade_off: No steering diode needed; requires a split-output driver.

alternatives.approach: Two steering diodes fully decoupling R_ON and R_OFF
alternatives.trade_off: Fully independent values; one more diode in the gate loop.
